title: Butterfly holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M50 38 Q54 46 52 54' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='21' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <path d='M50 40 l-3 4 h6 z' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <!-- butterfly body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='4' ry='11' fill='#8a5cf6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4.5' fill='#a97cff'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M48 47 Q44 40 41 37' stroke='#a97cff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 47 Q56 40 59 37' stroke='#a97cff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='36.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- left wings -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='52' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#4dd6c1' transform='rotate(-25 32 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='70' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#2fb8a4' transform='rotate(20 34 70)'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='55' r='2' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='69' r='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- right wings -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='52' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#4dd6c1' transform='rotate(25 68 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='70' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#2fb8a4' transform='rotate(-20 66 70)'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='55' r='2' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='69' r='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- little arms holding string -->
  <path d='M53 58 Q57 57 55.5 54' stroke='#a97cff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
